title: The Field Hospital
text: Tents of rotten canvas sag over rows of cots, and the smell of old medicine still hangs in the air, sharp and sweet. The cots are not all empty. Some of the supplies are still sealed, stacked by a surgeon's table that was never cleaned.

options.label: The best healer goes through the stores.

outcomes.text: Bandages, salves, and a surgeon's notes that make sense.

options.label: The worst hurt gets a cot for an hour.

outcomes.text: An hour of real rest, in a real bed.
An hour of rest, and a dream about whoever had the cot before.

options.label: Strip the tents for anything worth selling.
